purpose: Before any PPARG docking, exclude coordinate-eligible structures with globally incomplete standard amino-acid templates and repeat the unchanged deterministic max-min selection.
trigger: The first coordinate-only selection showed that 7 of 24 selected structures contain globally incomplete standard amino-acid templates outside the frozen pocket anchors. Deterministic completion would add unnecessary modeling uncertainty, so this label-independent preparation-readiness rule is frozen before receptor preparation or any docking score is read.

selection.selection_rule: unchanged deterministic max-min standardized pocket distance over the preparation-ready pool; ties resolved by lexical conformer ID

interpretation_boundary: This prospective technical correction uses coordinates only and prevents unregistered residue modeling. It cannot establish redocking success, enrichment, QUBO portability, QUBO superiority, quantum execution, or quantum advantage.
